# Arcmira

The shared procedure for Arcmira, the search engine for the spoken web: answer what YouTube shows and podcasts said — transcripts with timestamps, mentions, sponsors, on-air recommendations and momentum — through the remote Arcmira MCP server (arcmira_describe, arcmira_execute_read, arcmira_execute_write, arcmira_feedback), resolving every name to a verbatim id before filtering, citing returned passages, naming the entity used, and setting up credited monitors only after confirmation. Instruction file only; use requires an Arcmira account and spends metered credits.
